messages:
jordan: Quick sync 1: we need owners for customer comms after the inference service regression. Specifically: 1) 72h customer note, 2) public statuspage blurb, 3) RCA-sharing rules for enterprise requests, and 4) mark recurring-pattern if applicable.
mei: I can draft the 72h note. Will aim for a short impact summary + what were doing next.
oscar: I'll take the public status blurb and confirm exact windows with infra.
pri: I'll own RCA-sharing rules coordination with legal/privacy. We should set a clear redaction checklist.
comms-bot: Postmortem page created: https://redwood/pms/1799001111 (editable)
jordan: Proposed deadlines: status blurb +24h, 72h note +48h, redaction rules +36h, legal review within 24h after that.
mei: Redaction checklist draft: - no raw stack traces, - mask IPs/hostnames, - anonymize customer IDs (show counts), - avoid vendor names in public copy unless cleared.
oscar: Suggested public wording draft:
```
We experienced a temporary degradation in inference performance affecting a subset of requests between 14:02-14:45 UTC. The issue has been mitigated and normal service has resumed. We are investigating the root cause and will provide updates.
```
pri: Legal note: for enterprise RCA access, require a ticket + legal cc; consider a redacted RCA and offer a scheduled deep-dive under NDA for sensitive cases.
jordan: Also flagging recurring-pattern: platform noted similar scaling regressions in last 60 days. Tagging incident as "recurring-pattern" and asking platform-eng to prepare short internal summary. Do not include pattern details in public notes unless legal approves.
mei: Adding actions to tracker: ACTION-6010: Status blurb (oscar) +24h; ACTION-6011: 72h note (mei) +48h; ACTION-6012: Redaction checklist (pri) +36h; ACTION-6013: Legal review (legal) within 24h of ACTION-6012; ACTION-6014: Recurring-pattern memo (platform-eng) +3d; ACTION-6015: Verification plan (infra + SRE) +7d.
oscar: I'll ping infra now for timestamps and start the status blurb.
pri: I'll draft the redaction checklist and loop legal & privacy.
jordan: Thanks all. I'll compile drafts into the postmortem when ready. Please update the tracker as you start work. :thumbsup:
